content.text: Submitted. The repair kept the single concise insertion but fixed the two precision failures: the fee limb now reads "the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim" (claim anchor, lowercase fee basis, no defined-term dependency), and the payment-obligations sentence now covers all amounts due under the Agreement and states expressly that they are not "damages" for purposes of the cap. I also trimmed the surplus damages categories to the required indirect/consequential exclusion and used the checklist spelling "wilful misconduct"; all preferred carve-outs remain uncapped and nothing else in the Agreement changes.
